evals.name: fresh-orientation-before-teaching
evals.prompt: 帮我精读 evals/files/aggregation-paper.md。我在做 PV+ESS colocation，最关心多个分布式储能怎样聚合提供电网服务，以及集中式和分布式架构怎么选；电池化学不用深入。我还没有读过论文。先建立阅读路线给我确认，这一轮不要开始正文教学。
evals.expected_output: Surveys the synthetic source, proposes a filter-specific route table with Depth, Progress, and Why, explicitly skips chemistry with a reason, and waits for route agreement before teaching.
expectations: Produces a per-section route table with Depth, Progress, and filter-specific Why columns
Explicitly deprioritizes or skips Appendix A and preserves the chemistry-related reason in its row
Uses the route table as the only proposed in-note progress source
Does not begin deep section teaching before the requested route-confirmation turn
Every section title and rationale is grounded in the supplied synthetic source rather than invented

evals.name: guided-first-read-multiturn
evals.prompt: 阅读路线已经确认，当前从 evals/files/aggregation-paper.md 的 §3.1 开始。我还没读过这一节。请模拟接下来的三个导师回复：我的消息依次是（1）‘开始吧’；（2）‘懂了，继续’；（3）‘所以集中式一定比分布式好吗？’。
evals.expected_output: A three-response guided-reading transcript: bounded source explanation first, continuation after the learner says continue, then a direct source-bounded response to the architecture question. Questions are sparse rather than mechanically appended.
expectations: The first tutor response explains a bounded piece of §3.1 before any comprehension question
The second tutor response continues the source explanation rather than forcing a teach-back gate
The three tutor responses do not each end with a comprehension question
The answer to whether centralized is always better distinguishes the paper's stated tradeoff from unsupported generalization
Uses exact page, section, figure, or table locators from the synthetic source

evals.name: resume-and-migrate-legacy-note
evals.prompt: 接着 evals/files/legacy-study-notes.md 继续读 evals/files/aggregation-paper.md。先把旧笔记里重复的学习进度块和优先级表迁移成单一的路线表，再从真正未完成的位置继续；不要重讲已经完成的 §1 和 §2。
evals.expected_output: Reads the old note and source, migrates state row-by-row into one route table with a precise restart boundary, preserves skip reasons, removes the obsolete mutable block, and resumes at §3.1 after the recorded data-flow description.
expectations: Preserves completed §1 and §2 rather than restarting
Adds Progress to the existing priority table while preserving Depth and Why
Records §3.1 as in progress with an exact restart boundary after the data-flow description
Keeps Appendix A visible as skipped with its original reason
Removes the obsolete standalone completed/current/pending block only after transferring all states
Does not invent a conflict between trackers that agree

evals.name: multi-paper-synthesis
evals.prompt: 我们已经确认这样读：evals/files/aggregation-paper.md 精读 §2–4、跳过 Appendix A；evals/files/aging-paper.md 精读 §2–3、§1 中读。请建立每篇各自的学习笔记和一个 synthesis.md，开始梳理聚合目标函数与电池老化成本之间的冲突。
evals.expected_output: Separate note per paper with its own route-and-progress table, plus a synthesis file with terminology mapping, source-grounded tension, shared gaps, and precise locators.
expectations: Creates a separate note for each synthetic paper
Each paper note has one route table with Progress and no duplicate mutable tracker
Creates a separate synthesis file with a terminology-mapping table
Explains that aggregation Eq. 1 omits degradation cost while aging Eq. 2 introduces throughput cost
Identifies allocation of degradation cost among independently owned sites as a gap not covered by either source
Uses exact synthetic page and equation locators without presenting fixtures as real publications

evals.name: quoted-foldable-tangent
evals.prompt: 路线已经确认，我们正在读 evals/files/aggregation-paper.md §3。论文只说 distributed price coordination，没有提 ADMM。我想用 evals/files/admm-background.md 比较 ADMM，但那是支线。请给出要写进笔记的片段：论文主线保持可见，ADMM 背景放可折叠注释，并把路线表中的进度更新到准确位置。
evals.expected_output: Visible source-grounded main line, a fully blockquoted details annotation for ADMM, clear epistemic labels, and a single route-table Progress update without a duplicate tracker.
expectations: Keeps the paper's distributed price-coordination claim visible outside the fold
Does not attribute ADMM or a convergence proof to the synthetic paper
Every line from <details> through </details>, including blank separators, begins with >
Labels paper content, external background, and research inference separately
Uses evals/files/admm-background.md as the source for the ADMM branch
Updates §3 Progress in the route table and does not create a separate progress block
Does not hide a source-boundary warning solely inside the fold

evals.name: already-read-targeted-questioning
evals.prompt: 阅读路线已经确认。我已经读过 evals/files/aggregation-paper.md §2，并写下：‘Eq. 1 里的 reserve_shortfall_penalty 就是电池老化成本，所以作者已经处理了 degradation。’请不要从头重讲；先指向相关原文，再用一个聚焦问题帮我定位这个理解哪里需要重新检查。
evals.expected_output: Treats the current chunk as already read, points back to the exact Eq. 1 terms, and asks one focused comparison question that exposes the mismatch rather than replaying a first-read lecture.
expectations: Does not restart the paper or re-teach all of §2
Points to p.2 Eq. 1 and distinguishes reserve shortfall from battery degradation
Uses the learner's written interpretation as evidence and asks one focused comparison question about the terms in Eq. 1
Does not falsely claim the synthetic paper includes a degradation term
Explains enough to repair the misconception rather than asking an empty question
